basics.name: Gyeongdeok Seo
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Statistics
basics.summary: I am a Ph.D. student in Statistics at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. My research interests are causal inference, structural causal models, and probabilistic machine learning.

work.name: Yonsei University
work.position: Graduate Researcher — advised by Prof. Kyungwoo Song
highlights: Developed FANS (Function And Noise Separation), a framework using normalizing flows to detect and dissect causal mechanism shifts into changes in the causal function or the noise distribution.
Proposed a statistical criterion based on independence between flow-generated noise residuals and parent variables to distinguish function-driven and noise-driven shifts in structural causal models.
Filed a Korean patent application, *Method and Apparatus for Detecting and Analyzing Causal Mechanism Shifts* (pending).

work.name: Vaccine Safety and Causality Monitoring Project
work.position: Graduate Researcher — advised by Prof. Kyungwoo Song
work.summary: Establishment of a monitoring system and methodology to verify the causality of adverse reactions of major interest after vaccination.
highlights: Designed static and dynamic scoring models for post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 (PASC) in a Korean cohort using logistic lasso and functional logistic lasso regression; identified differences in chest pain scores among Omicron wave sub-cohorts.
Constructed a dynamic scoring system with time-varying coefficients based on Functional Principal Component Analysis (FPCA) of longitudinal data.

work.name: Global Research on Regulatory Evaluation of Biohealth Products
work.summary: Global Collaborative Research for Advancing Regulatory Science and Technology in Safety and Efficacy Evaluation of Biohealth Products, funded by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, Korea.
highlights: Presented chapters of *Causal Inference: What If* in a bi-weekly seminar and presented on detecting mechanism shifts to identify unmeasured confounders.

work.name: NAVER FINANCIAL
highlights: Engineered a data mart and time-series forecasting models to automate reporting; developed interactive controllers for a commerce expert and integrated outputs into dashboards for proactive risk detection.
Analyzed Naver Pay payment trends and simulated promotion scenarios to support business decisions.

work.name: CC&I Research
highlights: Evaluated non-inferiority of a client's new device against the original using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test to compare study endpoints.
Exchange student, Georgia Institute of Technology (Fall 2021).
Leave of absence for military service, Republic of Korea Air Force (February 2018–January 2020).
